Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps must be connected to Microsoft Office 365 through the
connector. To connect Defender for Cloud Apps, see Connect Microsoft 365 to Microsoft
Defender for Cloud Apps.
App Governance must be turned on. Refer to the app governance documentation to turn it on.
Mailboxes are required to be hosted in Exchange Online.
The following mailbox events need to be audited by minimum:
MailItemsAccessed
UpdateInboxRules
MoveToDeletedItems
SoftDelete
HardDelete
Review manage mailbox auditing to learn about managing mailbox auditing.

activate accounts that were deactivated by attack disruption while an attack is detected.
